dct_description_sm: "Soil interpretive map of important farmlands." "Base edited by the Geological Survey; compiled from USGS 1:24 000-scale topographic maps dated 1958-1973." "Planimetry revised from photographs taken 1975-1976." "Projection and 10 000 meter grid ticks, zone 16: Universal Transverse Mercator." "25 000-foot grid ticks based on Georgia coordinate system, west zone." "September 1978. 4-R-36841." Includes vicinity map.
dct_publisher_sm: Dept. of Agriculture, Soil Conservation Service (Fort Worth, Tex)
